testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.tenancy.TenantAccessTests

testcase.name: SYSTEM_ADMIN keeps the platform operations - member management and tenant administration()
SYSTEM_ADMIN that is a member gets exactly its member permissions (no bypass on top)()
AccessContext carries the tenant resolved from the workspace()
forPlatform needs an enabled system admin and forTenant hides foreign tenants()
TENANT_ADMIN is a tenant-level role only - no implicit access to workspace business data()
SYSTEM_ADMIN default policy - platform scope only, no business data of a workspace it is not a member of()
tenant admin API - platform operations need SYSTEM_ADMIN, membership operations need TENANT_MEMBERS on that tenant()
a member removed from the tenant loses access to its workspaces, and a suspended tenant is closed to ordinary users()
